analysisProtocol.bootstrapUnit: sourceSeed; all rows from a sampled source remain together
analysisProtocol.teacherBoundary: Native transfer metrics use only native rows; archived vendored rows are joined by exact source/state for descriptive agreement tables only. No cross-teacher pooling or bootstrap is performed.

candidate.t2Rule: T2_revive: curHp = floor(maxHP/2) for WIN_CONSUMED conditional CTM heads

claimBoundary: No runtime support was integrated; production remains active_unqualified_lizard.

freshnessAudit.searched: all docs/experiments/evidence/lizard_tail* JSON/JSONL manifests and sourceSeed rows, plus exact seven-digit seed mentions in docs/experiments/ledger-06.md and docs/knowledge-base/evaluation/current-research.md

sourceAssignment.hard96Selection: one prospective-support eligible combat per source maximizing frozen q*(1-r); fightIdx ascending on exact ties
sourceAssignment.partitionRule: Preassign by ascending sourceSeed: first 96 are HARD96, final 32 are BROAD32; fixed before candidate generation.

nativeTeacherTransferAgreement.claimBoundary: descriptive agreement table only; teachers are analyzed separately and never pooled

nativeTeacherTransferAssessment.clearRegressionRule: stop if any source-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound for candidate-vs-B1 three-class NLL/Brier in pooled/HARD/BROAD, learned-r NLL/Brier, or T2 HP/expected-HP/downstream metrics is above zero
